messages:
aj: quick style sweep on PR #1522, a couple tiny nits from lint and one naming question. planning to merge after approvals today if nothing blocks

maria: I left two comments: prefer `snake_case` for config keys (we've standardized on that). small docs nit too.

ben: saw the lint failure in CI, looks like an import order issue. running `isort` locally fixed it for me.

aj: thanks, ben. which import ordering rule triggered? I can re-run formatter before merge.

ben: it's the one that groups stdlib / third-party / local. file is `src/runtime/router.py`, you can do `pipx run isort src/runtime/router.py` or `python -m isort src/runtime/router.py`.

maria: also: variable name `reqId` -> `request_id`. tiny but helps logging parity across services.

leo: quick question on merge timing — I'm about to cut a small release that includes the routing perf patch. if this lands before the cut (2:30pm PT) I can include it, otherwise we'll hold for next PR.

aj: I can sweep and merge before 2:15pm PT if approvals come in. tagging for 👀: @maria @ben @sasha

sasha: quick review now. approved with one suggestion: prefer `Optional[str]` annotation instead of `Union[str, None]` in that module. tiny change, happy to approve after. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: check run for PR #1522 — tests: passed ✅, lint: failed ⚠️ (isort/order) — full log: https://ci.example.com/build/1522

aj: pushing `isort` + rename commit in a sec. will include a brief commit msg: "style: isort + rename reqId -> request_id"

maria: thanks. for the docs nit, can you also update the inline example to `request_id`? saves a follow-up.

aj: done, pushed 1934567923. pinging CI.

ci-bot: rerun check for PR #1522 — tests: passed ✅, lint: passed ✅

ben: LGTM, approving now.

sasha: approve as well.

leo: rolling release window moved up 10m, still good. merge when ready.

aj: merging now. thanks everyone! :party_parrot:

ci-bot: PR #1522 merged by aj at 1934568032.
